boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A flexible, under-21-safe campus sequence built around documented landmarks, public collections, gardens, and recreation.

cards.title: Start at Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: Green and Wright streets, Urbana
cards.notes: Begin with a look at Lorado Taft’s three-figure Alma Mater statue, then use the nearby campus streets to orient yourself before crossing into the Quad.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable campus landmark at the Quad entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois identifies the Alma Mater as an iconic university symbol; it was created by alumnus and sculptor Lorado Taft and depicts three women in scholastic robes.
cards.source_title: Community | Global Education and Training | Illinois
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; view from surrounding public walkways.

cards.title: Get oriented inside the Illini Union
cards.subtitle: 1401 W. Green Street, Urbana
cards.notes: Use the building maps to locate the main-level study areas and art gallery, then note the lower-level Rec Room and seating for a later stop.
cards.short_summary: A mapped campus hub with study, gallery, dining, and recreation areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Illini Union’s building information lists study spaces and an art gallery on the main level, plus the Rec Room, restaurants, and open seating on the lower level.
cards.access_notes: Check the Union’s current building and vendor hours before going.

cards.title: Walk the Main Quad
cards.subtitle: Between Illini Union and Foellinger Auditorium
cards.notes: Take the central lawn route from the Union toward Foellinger Auditorium, pausing to identify the buildings framing the campus’s principal quadrangle.
cards.short_summary: The central open space connecting two major campus landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois describes the Main Quad as an open grassy area at the heart of campus, anchored by the Illini Union to the north and Foellinger Auditorium to the south.
cards.source_title: Community | Global Education and Training | Illinois
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted campus rules and event setup boundaries.

cards.title: See Foellinger’s copper dome
cards.subtitle: 709 S. Mathews Avenue, Urbana
cards.notes: Continue to the south end of the Quad for an exterior look at Foellinger Auditorium, then check its schedule if you want to return for a public program.
cards.short_summary: A historic Quad auditorium used for classes and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Foellinger Auditorium has served as both classroom and performance space since its original 1907 dedication and is located at the south end of the Quad.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is the suggested stop; entry depends on building access and scheduled events.

cards.title: View the Morrow Plots from the walkways
cards.subtitle: South Quad near the Undergraduate Library
cards.notes: Observe the plots from the surrounding paths and keep outside the research area; the site is visible year-round but is not open for entry.
cards.short_summary: A protected, active agricultural research landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois states that the Morrow Plots are visible to visitors year-round, but as an active research site and National Historic Landmark they are not open for entry.
cards.source_title: Contact | Morrow Plots | College of Agricultural, Consumer & Environmental Sciences | Illinois
cards.access_notes: View only from surrounding walkways; do not enter the plots.

cards.title: Settle into Main Library Room 220
cards.subtitle: 1408 W. Gregory Drive, Urbana
cards.notes: Use Room 220 for a short reset, choosing a table or reserving a study room if available; covered drinks are permitted in this specific space.
cards.short_summary: A documented Main Library study area with seating and reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Main Library Room 220 has 83 seats, 29 tables, four reservable study rooms, and permits drinks in covered containers.
cards.source_title: Main Library – Room 220 | University Library | Illinois
cards.access_notes: Consult the page’s live hours before visiting; room availability can vary.

cards.title: Browse Krannert Art Museum galleries
cards.subtitle: 500 E. Peabody Drive, Champaign
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit during posted public hours, keep food and drinks out of the galleries, and take personal-use photos only where signage allows.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art museum with public galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: Krannert Art Museum states that admission is always free and lists public hours Tuesday through Saturday, including Thursday evening hours when classes are in session.
cards.source_title: Know Before You Go | Krannert Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Check current hours before visiting; personal-use photography is permitted unless otherwise posted.

cards.title: Explore Spurlock Museum exhibits
cards.subtitle: 600 S. Gregory Street, Urbana
cards.notes: Add a museum stop for permanent or temporary exhibits, following the museum’s visitor guidance on photography, bags, food, and gallery conduct.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum presenting cultural collections and exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spurlock Museum visitor brochure lists free general admission and describes permanent and temporary exhibits representing historic and contemporary peoples worldwide.
cards.access_notes: Review current museum hours before visiting; follow gallery rules for bags, food, and photography.

cards.title: Stroll the Japan House Gardens
cards.subtitle: 2000 S. Lincoln Avenue, Urbana
cards.notes: Make a daylight garden walk near the Arboretum, using the established paths and garden etiquette; the tea garden’s rocky path closes in winter.
cards.short_summary: A traditional Japanese garden open for self-guided strolling.
cards.evidence_claim: Japan House says visitors are welcome to walk through its gardens on their own from dawn to dusk, with the tea garden closed during winter for safety.
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk; review garden etiquette and note that the tea garden’s rocky path closes in winter.

cards.title: End with a Rec Room game
cards.subtitle: Illini Union lower level, 1401 W. Green Street, Urbana
cards.notes: Meet up for bowling, pool, or air hockey in the Union Rec Room; confirm the day’s operating hours and rates before committing to an activity.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation space with bowling lanes, billiards, and games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Illini Union Rec Room offers 14 bowling lanes, billiards, air hockey, and other recreation; the bowling page lists per-game and shoe-rental rates.
cards.access_notes: Check current Rec Room hours and rates; bowling and games require payment.
